svg.title: Molecule of the day: Warfarin
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Warfarin while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 1.36.
svg.text: MW 308.3 · cLogP 3.61 · TPSA 67.5 · HBD 1 · HBA 4 · RotB 4
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
